<function name="GetBoneController" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns the value of the bone controller with the specified ID.

<note>This is the precursor of pose parameters, and only works for Half Life 1: Source models supporting it.</note>
	</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="boneID" type="number">ID of the bone controller. Goes from 0 to 3.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">The value set on the bone controller.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
